atoms.text: This level includes mentions of uncomfortable situations both at school and at home. If this level upsets you, you should speak with a trusted adult about it.

instruction.text: Decide whether the situation would be comfortable or uncomfortable.

atoms.a: Keelan’s friend has told him that he is being bullied, but asks Keelan not to tell anyone else.

feedback.end: This situation would be uncomfortable for Keelan, since he would be worried about his friend.
If a secret could end up with people being hurt or upset, or makes you worry about the people involved, it is best to tell an adult you trust and ask them for help.

b.sound: keep the secret because his friend asked him to
tell an adult what is going on and ask them to help

instruction.text: Decide whether the situation would be comfortable or uncomfortable.

hint.text: Being touched inappropriately includes any type of physical contact that you are not comfortable with, including someone touching your private parts.
hint.label: Inappropriately

atoms.a: Kayleigh’s football coach touched her inappropriately at training this evening and asked her not to tell anyone about it.

feedback.end: This situation would be uncomfortable for Kayleigh, since something happened that is never okay. She feels pressured not to talk about it with anyone.

If anyone touches you inappropriately, you should tell a trusted adult as soon as possible.
If you feel like there are no adults you can tell, you can call Childline using the number 0800 1111.

b.sound: keep the secret for her football coach
tell a trusted adult immediately about what happened

instruction.text: Decide whether the situation would be comfortable or uncomfortable.

atoms.a: Simon is unsure of which toy to buy from the shop. His friend suggests a toy that he enjoys playing with.

feedback.end: This situation isn’t uncomfortable. Simon’s friend isn’t pressuring him to buy something he doesn’t want, just offering some help to make the decision easier.

instruction.text: Decide whether the situation would be comfortable or uncomfortable.

atoms.a: Dhruv tells his best friend everything, including things he thought were secrets. Now, he has found out that his friend has been telling his secrets to other people.
atoms.sound: Droov tells his best friend everything, including things he thought were secrets. Now, he has found out that his friend has been telling his secrets to other people.

end.text: This situation would be uncomfortable for Dhruv. His friend has broken his trust and shared secrets that Dhruv wanted to keep private.
end.sound: This situation would be uncomfortable for Droov. His friend has broken his trust and shared secrets that Droov wanted to keep private.

feedback.end: Make sure to tell people how and why they’ve hurt your feelings so they can learn to be nicer and more considerate in the future.

b.sound: start hitting his friend because he hurt his feelings and broke his trust
tell his friend how he feels and explain why his actions weren’t okay
